title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Bethel University
description: A guide to the essential late-night food and study breaks for Bethel students, featuring on-campus staples and nearby local favorites open after hours.

cards.title: Royal Grounds
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Coffee and Subs
cards.notes: Located in Brushaber Commons, this spot serves Caribou Coffee and hot sub sandwiches until 10:30 p.m. on weeknights.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus late-night study and snack hub at Bethel University.
cards.evidence_claim: Royal Grounds is open Monday through Thursday until 10:30 p.m. and serves hot sub sandwiches and Freschetta pizzas starting after 6 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:30 p.m. Monday-Thursday; closed weekends.

cards.title: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Breakfast Hub
cards.notes: A classic 24-hour diner located just south of campus, popular for late-night pancakes and study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A reliable 24/7 diner serving breakfast and bakery items near the Bethel campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Perkins location at 1495 County Road B West in Roseville is open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Perkins at 1495 County Road B West Roseville, MN

cards.title: Raising Cane's
cards.subtitle: Post-Game Chicken Runs
cards.notes: A frequent stop for students seeking chicken fingers and Cane's Sauce, open until 1:00 a.m. on weekends.
cards.short_summary: Popular fast-food chain known for chicken fingers, located a short drive from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shoreview location at 3780 Lexington Ave N is open until midnight Sunday-Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday-Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 a.m. on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: Midnight Snack Stop
cards.notes: Conveniently located on County Road E, this location serves the late-night menu until midnight.
cards.short_summary: Standard late-night fast food option located in nearby Arden Hills.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 1313 W County Road E in Arden Hills is open until 12:00 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Arden Hills, MN at 1313 W County Road E | McDonald's

cards.title: Davanni's
cards.subtitle: Local Pizza and Hoagies
cards.notes: A Twin Cities favorite for hot hoagies and pizza, located just north of the Bethel campus.
cards.short_summary: Local pizza and hoagie chain popular for group orders and casual dining.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arden Hills location at 3673 Lexington Ave N is a established local spot for pizza and hoagies near Bethel.
cards.access_notes: Typically open until 9:00 p.m. or 10:00 p.m.; check seasonal hours.

cards.title: 3900 Grill
cards.subtitle: Evening Grill Specials
cards.notes: Located outside the main dining center, offering grilled specials and paninis until 7:00 p.m. on weeknights.
cards.short_summary: On-campus retail dining location offering fresh grilled items and Mediterranean cuisine.
cards.evidence_claim: 3900 Grill is open Monday through Thursday until 7:00 p.m. for grilled and pressed items.
cards.access_notes: Open until 7:00 p.m. Monday-Thursday; closed weekends.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Cravings
cards.notes: A go-to for late-night tacos and burritos, with drive-thru service often available past midnight.
cards.short_summary: Fast-food Mexican-inspired chain with late-night drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 2219 Highway 10 in Mounds View/Arden Hills area serves the local community with late-night options.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® Restaurant Near Me in Saint Paul, MN
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru typically open late; check specific daily hours.

cards.title: Monson Dining Center
cards.subtitle: The Main Dining Hall
cards.notes: Known as 'The DC,' this is the primary buffet-style dining area on campus for dinner until 7:00 p.m.
cards.short_summary: Bethel's largest on-campus dining facility offering a variety of stations and community seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Monson Dining Center is open for dinner until 7:00 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Dinner hours end at 7:00 p.m. on weekdays and 6:30 p.m. on weekends.

cards.title: The Original Malt Shop
cards.subtitle: Classic Malts and Burgers
cards.notes: A nostalgic spot for burgers and thick malts, located south of campus in Roseville.
cards.short_summary: Classic American malt shop serving traditional burgers and ice cream treats.
cards.evidence_claim: The Original Malt Shop at 1125 Larpenteur Ave W in Roseville is a local destination for malts and burgers.
cards.access_notes: Typically open until 8:00 p.m. or 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Snuffy's Malt Shop
cards.subtitle: Retro Diner Experience
cards.notes: A 1950s-style diner known for its burgers and malts, located in the Highland Park area of St. Paul.
cards.short_summary: Iconic Twin Cities malt shop offering a retro dining experience.
cards.evidence_claim: Snuffy's Malt Shop is a well-known local chain for burgers and malts in the St. Paul area.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by location; check website for current status.
